decisions.reason: The source establishes the referenced platform's beige and font-color styling but does not change the machine placard text, faces, or placement.
The beige and font-color decision does not alter the existing DJ-turntable visual theme.
The source concerns platform color and font styling, not bowl capacity, form, or mixing priorities.
The platform's structural purpose and type remain unchanged; color and font styling are owned by the source visual-design Requirement.
Matching the platform's beige and font colors does not change the component-sourcing or custom-spout strategy.
The source changes visual styling only and does not alter enclosure dimensions, side profile, or bowl-well accommodation.
The platform color and font decision has no necessary effect on splash-control behavior or methods.
The source does not change the existing requirement that cups fit beneath the spouts; it only specifies platform styling.
The visual styling decision does not alter valve dripping, seals, or liquid-containment behavior.
The source does not modify the spout's location, orientation, geometry, or fabrication style.
The beige and font-color styling does not change the base-stability or vibration-resistance requirement.
The source does not request a BOM revision or change the BOM deliverable or its approval state.
